customManagers.description: scripts/install-typst.sh downloads the typst release of its TYPST_VERSION, which no built-in manager reads. This manager reads the line under its renovate comment. The release tags carry a 'v' prefix, the pin does not. Renovate does not update TYPST_SHA256_X86_64 and TYPST_SHA256_AARCH64: copy them by hand from the asset digests of the new release (GitHub's release API or release page). Until then the script refuses the new archives, so a bump without the hashes fails closed.
